tests/connectors/test_connectors.py:150-153 runs SELECT "quote_ident"(tenant_id) with RLS rule tenant_id='alpha' and asserts ["alpha"]. PostgreSQL quote_ident adds double quotes only when needed (non-lowercase letters/digits/underscore, leading digit, or reserved keyword). 'alpha' is plain lowercase and not a reserved keyword, so it is returned unquoted. Based on documented PostgreSQL behavior; not executed against a live database.
